config.design: 6 families x8 query items x2 controls x2 formats, four demonstrations each. Full-vocabulary next-token accuracy. Qualify family/form only if task>=6/8 and copy>=6/8. All cells retained. Frozen manifest/config before model loading.
config.limitations: New prompts, reused vocabulary and query items. Competence screening, not independent intervention validation. Agreement copying always The; its control does not establish item-sensitive copying. One fixed demonstration order; answer length single token only.
